limits: Not extracted original-game animation or a certified pixel-perfect recreation. Native alpha fringe is preserved; hard alpha>=16 bodies are fully isolated by two source-pixel crop margins.
Body proportions and source perspectives retain modest native drawing variation. displayHeight145 is the existing gameplay display unit, not a claim of 145cm.
Both directions are independently drawn in source regions; the two-row walk PNG has left and right regions, never mirrored.
All 52 original bodies are retained in the native region registry. Combat action groups reuse appropriate keyposes; these are not 52 separate animation actions.
